errors.text: The loss of the smallest particles is primarily attributed to Ostwald ripening and growth of surviving particles, whereas the target mechanism emphasizes Au/Cu surface segregation followed by melting and evaporation, producing an overall particle-size reduction.
The predicted spherical-to-faceted shape evolution conflicts with the observed elliptical-to-spherical reshaping.
The boundary omits the experimentally important onset of instability near 673 K and instead proposes unsupported particle-size thresholds of 10 and 50 nm.
